output.reason: [ev-bacdc0376810] only says the default logging was switched to JSON. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected or stops working, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind. However, the proposed statement says the old default was "text", and the remediation names a --log-format flag and an ARGOCD_LOG_FORMAT environment variable. The evidence supports neither detail, so I corrected the statement and remediation to say only what the evidence says.

correction.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 switches the default logging format to JSON. Environments relying on the default will produce JSON-formatted logs. Logging still works, but tooling that consumes the logs should be checked.

consequence.statement: Where the logging format is left at its default, Argo CD now logs in JSON. Logs are still produced, but in a different format, so any log parsing, monitoring or alerting that expects the previous format may need updating.
consequence.remediation: Check that log parsing, monitoring and alerting can handle JSON-formatted Argo CD logs, or explicitly configure the logging format if a different format is required.
